text: The religious experts knew the exact town where God's promised King would be born. The Bible never says they went to look.
About seven hundred years earlier, Micah, a prophet, a man who spoke God's message, named one small town.
But thou, Bethlehem... out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel.
When Jesus was born there, visitors from the east came looking for a newborn King. So King Herod asked the experts where He would be born.
Micah also said this ruler is "from everlasting." He did not begin in Bethlehem. He came as a baby, died for our sins, and rose from the dead on the third day.
